### Source
Git history and GitHub PRs, read-only.

### What I searched
- File history and CLI blame for `DeclarationIngestionStage::Load`.
- Commits `5c275ca`, `1622626`, `7009ffa`, `355edab`.
- Full PR bodies, comments, reviews, linked issues for #25, #26, #28, #31, #32, #36.
- `git log --all -S '01a120ef-db40-7183-b9b1-70b941ae6f52'` returned no matches.
- History of `exposed/config/cli-dev.yaml`.

### Direct evidence
All PRs authored by `johnnylarner`.

- [PR #31](https://github.com/johnnylarner/exposed/pull/31), merged October 9: “Declaration loading rejected valid evidence labels produced by resolution v3.” It also records that unchanged captures failed because every timestamp had to advance. Verification states the “reported CLI command” subsequently loaded 10,928 declarations, 3,847 identities, and 8,595 funding occurrences; exact retry succeeded.
- [PR #32](https://github.com/johnnylarner/exposed/pull/32), merged October 9: “The loader maintained string vocabularies and result shapes separate from the resolution domain.” Its explicit rationale is preventing producer/consumer contract drift. Verification records that the original CLI retry succeeded.
- [PR #26](https://github.com/johnnylarner/exposed/pull/26), October 8: earlier failures involved structural parents and company-number/donor-kind mismatches. This was fixed and verified through a real load.
- [PR #25](https://github.com/johnnylarner/exposed/pull/25), October 8: loader introduction requires resolved artifacts and an appropriately upgraded schema. Its verification explicitly says the configured project database was not migrated.
- [PR #36](https://github.com/johnnylarner/exposed/pull/36), October 9: SQLx previously could not discover unversioned upgrade scripts. Versioned migrations fix discovery, but this PR also explicitly leaves the application database untouched.

### Circumstantial evidence
- `1622626` adds identity bases `extracted_name_link`, `trade_union_family_link`, `statistical_and_supporting_name_link` and pair reasons `extracted_name_evidence`, `trade_union_family`; timestamp comparison changes `<` to `<=`.
- `5c275ca` replaces loader-local string records with shared `ObservationResolution`, `PaymentAttribution`, `PairDecision` domain decoding.
- Current checkout includes both fixes. Therefore an outdated `target/debug/exposed` could retain either historical failure, but binary freshness was not inspected in this source-control investigation.
- CLI load implementation has remained unchanged since `80bacc1` / #25; the supplied command shape is consistent with that implementation.

### Contradictions
None in historical records. A present-day failure would conflict with recorded successful verification only if binary, artifact, configuration, and database states were identical; that equivalence remains unproved.

### Gaps
- No commit references the supplied ingestion key.
- PRs contain no comments, reviews, or linked issues.
- Exact present failure text and binary/database state cannot be established through Git/PR evidence.
- Historical successful command in #31 is described as “reported CLI command” without its literal invocation.
